parts.text: A drag car is a racing car that is powered by a rocket engine. A drag car accelerates uniformly from rest until it reaches the finishing line. The engine is then switched off and a parachute opens. The car decelerates until it stops. Fig. 2.1 shows a drag car decelerating after a race. Fig. 2.1 This drag car has a mass of 1400 kg. Fig. 2.2 is the speed–time graph for the car during a race on a straight horizontal track. Fig. 2.2 The car reaches its maximum speed of 130 m / s at a time of 6.5 s.
